title: Penance Brand Ignite Elementalist

stages.title: Level 1-12
stages.goal: Use Rolling Magma to clear groups while moving.

stages.title: Level 12-28
stages.goal: Keep Rolling Magma. Prepare Brand supports and elemental resistance gear.

stages.title: Level 28 to Maps
stages.goal: Test the Brand swap when the links and ignite setup are ready.

stages.title: Maps
stages.goal: Get a working mapping setup and cap elemental resistances.

stages.title: Red Maps
stages.goal: Use Ignite Proliferation for packs. Upgrade a piece at a time.

stages.title: Melding
stages.goal: Only use the Melding setup once you can meet its resistance requirements.

overview:
Use Rolling Magma in the early acts. Switch to Penance Brand after you have the appropriate ignite links.

Source guide by Goratha: https://pobarchives.com/build/hDYWRAVp
Original PoB: https://pobb.in/p_g4NPOmLxoP

PoB uses 3.29 simulation data. See the creator guide for assumptions and any additional stages.
